newsitem.title: USA: Freeport Resource Q2 off on lower prices.
newsitem.headline: Freeport Resource Q2 off on lower prices.

text.p: Freeport-McMoRan Resource Partners LP Tuesday reported lower second quarter earnings saying average sales prices for phosphate fertilizers for the quarter were slightly lower than the prior-year period and the previous quarter.
With very low phosphate fertilizer producer inventories, the near-term market outlook appears favorable, the partnership said.
Even with current expectations of good crop yields in North America, world grain stocks should remain at historically low levels, it continued.
